rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Presidency's statement of 1 March 2023 advises that Deputy President David Mabuza has resigned as a Member of Parliament, ending his term as Deputy President of the country.

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The same statement says the resignation follows Mabuza's request to President Ramaphosa to step down as Deputy President, which the President announced in his reply to the State of the Nation Address on 16 February 2023.

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The statement ends by saying the President will announce the appointment of a new Deputy President in due course.
